title: HPE security advisory (AV26-1011)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1011 Date: October 7, 2026 As of October 6, 2026, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: HPE Networking AOS-Switch (AOS-S) Version 16.11.0031 and prior HP Networking ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) Version 6.11.15 and prior Version 6.14.0 and prior The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. HPESBNW05158 rev.1 - Multiple Vulnerabilities in HPE Networking ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) HPESBNW05156 rev 1 - Multiple Vulnerabilities in HPE Networking AOS-Swtich (AOS-S) HPE Security Bulletin Library Article Link: HPE security advisory (AV26-1011) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
